description: This file defines an API endpoint class 'AttendanceEditPunchOutRecordOverlapAPI' in the OrangeHRM system. It handles the check for punch-out time overlaps when editing attendance records, including validation, permission checks, and interaction with the attendance data access object (DAO). The class provides a 'getOne' method that retrieves and verifies record overlap status based on provided punch-out details.

classes.name: AttendanceEditPunchOutRecordOverlapAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for checking punch-out record overlaps when editing attendance entries, providing validation, access control, and processing logic.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to verify if the punch-out time overlaps with existing attendance records during editing, by fetching the record, performing permission checks, calculating UTC times from offsets, and returning overlap status.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the 'getOne' method, ensuring required parameters are present and correctly formatted.

methods.name: getUTCTimeByOffsetAndDateTime
methods.description: Converts punch-in and punch-out date/time strings with offsets into UTC DateTime objects for comparison.
